title: De Morgan gate gadget
statement: Given a natural number $n$, a gate $g$, and a gate list $G$, the gadget returns a gate list and a vertex index. If $g$ is an OR gate, it first appends NOT gates for the distinct vertices in the argument list, then an AND gate reading their new indices, then a NOT gate reading the AND gate's index; it returns the resulting list and the index of the final NOT gate. If $g$ is an AND gate, it appends an AND gate reading the distinct arguments of $g$ and returns its index. If $g$ is a NOT gate, it appends $g$ itself and returns its index.
